description: Canonical structural reference for the unified MusashiMap data model. This is not a JSON Schema validator.
integrity_rules: Every cross-book chapter reference uses bNcN; legacy numeric fields may exist only during migration.
characters lists physical participants in an event; referenced_characters is used for named people involved only through letters, reports, memories or other non-present references.
character-state location is the physically established cartographic position at the end of the chapter; reported-only positions must use location:null and last_known_location when useful.
location_status values such as reported_position, unknown and departed_* must not be interpreted as physical presence.
character-state destination must not expose a future movement that is first established in a later chapter.
companions represent physical co-presence in the stated narrative state, not people merely mentioned in dialogue or reports.
appearance/presence without an established origin must not be encoded as a confirmed movement edge.
historical context is separate from novel evidence; external sources may explain a named historical entity but must not be used to invent narrative facts.
historical works are first-class contextual entities and are not modeled as characters or factions.
historical_status never implies narrative presence or map presence.
main-cast membership never implies physical presence.
unresolved locations do not receive invented coordinates.
hinagura and hinagura_stockade are distinct identifiers: the former denotes the broader area and the latter the specific fortified site.
locations persist from their first narrative appearance through the end of Book VII unless explicitly retired by future research rules.
